notes: Short: large private-wealth firm building 'advisor search' and compliance discovery features.
Indexing scale target: 100M - 130M documents (7-10 TB embeddings).
Workload profile: heavy read/query rate (avg 40-60 qps, peak 220 qps), low write churn (daily batch updates).
Latency targets: regional SLO - 95th <120ms (EU); 99th <200ms acceptable with graceful degradation.
Cost sensitivity: target cost < $0.002/query at 50 qps steady-state. High visibility from FinOps.
POC result snapshot: embeddings + reranker increased MRR +18% on internal eval sets; end-to-end tail latency spikes at sustained >150 qps without optimized batching.
Routing/failover: must support primary EU region (eu-west) with synchronous UK replica capable of taking full traffic within 30s. Automatic DNS + regional routing policy required.
Security: must run in customer VPC with KMS integration, SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, detailed audit logs (7 year retention request from compliance).
Quote (CTO Omar Ayodele): 'We will not move to a hosted vendor unless we can prove residency and reliable failover — auditability is non-negotiable.'
SE note: consider Dedicated EU cluster (pinned capacity) with on-prem gateway for extreme compliance lanes; Optimize recommendations: mixed precision + prefix cache for cost reduction.
use_case_summary: Primary: fast document search for advisors and compliance teams (RAG-style summarization & answer surfacing).
Secondary: reranking layer to improve precision for regulatory queries; embeddings for semantic matching across PDFs, emails, and transcripts.
requirements_summary: Index size: 100M+ documents, ~7-10TB embeddings storage; incremental nightly batch ingestion.
Throughput: steady 40-60 qps, burst to 220 qps; need predictable tail latency for SLAs.
Latency: EU region 95th <120ms; global failover acceptable with degraded latency (up to 250ms) during outage.
Failover: multi-region active-passive with <30s failover window; automatic routing + fallback to compatible model variant.
Security/Compliance: VPC-only control plane, KMS-managed keys, SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit log retention (requested 7 years), data residency in EU/UK.
Operational: token-level cost breakdowns, per-route dashboards, canary rollouts for reranker model changes, alerting on quality regressions.
